title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for the probability per unit time that the particle arrives at the observer a distance L away.

title: Wave Function Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly define the initial wave function psi_0(x) and its form as a Gaussian wave packet.

title: Current Density Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the expression for the current density j correctly from the wave function.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the correct integration steps leading to the final expression for psi(x, t).

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units in the final expression are consistent and correct.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in the final expression.
